cards.title: Two tracks, one estate
items: Structural: is each repository, and the territory, in shape?
PMO: is the work in the right place?
Structural runs first, so PMO judges what already passes

cards.title: Judgement above level 1
items: Only structural level 1 runs on existing rubrics and tooling
Every other level is a person or an agent reading and deciding
Lenses that do not apply are skipped without comment

cards.title: Captures move upwards
items: A level captures in the best place it knows at the time
Each PMO level re-reads and moves what the one below captured
Nothing is opened, closed or renamed without the owner
